mapper.select: SELECT t1.team_name AS supporting_team, t2.team_name AS opposing_team, st.stadium_name AS stadium, mr.team_result AS team_result, ht.team_name AS stadium_team, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(mr.match_date,'+00:00','+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS match_date, t1.team_code AS supporting_team_code, t2.team_code AS opposing_team_code, mr.supporting_team_score AS supporting_team_score, mr.opposing_team_score AS opposing_team_score, mr.seat AS seat, mr.review AS review FROM match_record mr JOIN team t1 ON t1.id = mr.supporting_team_id JOIN team t2 ON t2.id = mr.opposing_team_id JOIN stadium st ON st.id = mr.stadium_id LEFT JOIN team ht ON ht.id = st.team_id WHERE mr.id = #{recordId, jdbcType=BINARY, typeHandler=com.example.backend.global.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}
